facts.fact: The UN Women and Central Bureau of Statistics assessment (fieldwork March-July 2021, published 2021-12-21) treats Sudan's Statistics Act of 2003 as the current statistics law, calling it outdated and silent on gender statistics.

systems.system: National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS)

note: No rules made under or acts applied under the Act are stated; the NSDS and a new NSDS under development are class other.
